verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a registry and connection platform, but the evidence says the registry and hosted platform code are not public, so the core product cannot be self-hosted. Only the CLI client is open source (AGPL-3.0), and Uplink only exposes a user's own MCP server through Smithery's hosted service. Neither is a way to self-host Smithery itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
